name: Chart/Donut-Chart
description:
Donut chart: shares of one total as 5+ slices in palette order (Chart/Sector/Primary, Secondary, Support Cyan, Violet, Yellow Solid) with 2px gaps (Spacing/Gap/3XSmall), the ring 22% of the diameter, a Surface/Default % pill (Label/Small/Medium, Corner-Radius/Rounded) on every slice of 6% or more, the total in the centre (Heading/4 + Caption/Regular) and a legend below or at the start. Size (code: DonutChart size): Small 120 (the centre figure alone, Body/Base/Bold), Medium 168 (default), Large 240, XLarge 320 (Heading/3 figure). Pick Small for a tile or a row of several charts, Large or XLarge for a wide or tall card. Content only, no surface of its own: place it in a Chart-Card's (or a Card's) Content slot, and the card gives the theme. Code: DonutChart + ChartCard (src/components/Chart)


Color: Primary (default) · Secondary — Secondary swaps Color Chart Sector/Primary and /Secondary (the first two slices swap), for a chart led by Neutral Deep with the brand as its highlight. Code: palette="secondary".


Header: Title · Show Hint — an info icon (20px, Content/Neutral/Light) that holds the chart's description in a Tooltip (code: hint) · Show Open; Show Icon is off by default (chart headers carry no icon). Metric: Show Metric Label (Body/Small/Regular, what the figure is; code: metricLabel) over Show Value (Display/4).
